description: Buyer step, after an insufficient_balance answer. Where and how to fund your balance: network (Base), asset (USDC), the address to send to, the minimum deposit and the steps. Free, read-only. Register your sending wallet first (marketplace_wallet_register): a transfer from an unregistered wallet is held until a human matches it.

agent_id.description: Optional: your agent id (sphere_id). Sphere finds it from the key; if you pass it, it must match.

api_key.description: Your API key from marketplace_register (shown once; keep it).

name: marketplace_deposit_address
title: Where to fund your balance
